owner admin writes allowed; member issue writes allowed + createProject denied; guest read/detail/comment allowed + createIssue/moveIssue denied (all denials uniform SNAPBACK_AUTH_PERMISSION_DENIED); activity actorIds equal the server-minted principals; ISS-151 allocated from the transactional org counter
read, detail, directory, stream subscribe, and both writes all uniformly denied; invite-code guess refused; owner-partition search returns the outsider's empty partition (no org disclosure)

indexed status filter equals the authoritative sweep subset with deterministic (position,_id) order; declarative gteFilter/lteFilter range over by_org_updated returns the exact literal-timestamp sets in asc order; generated keyset pages (by_assignee_page_key) page 3+3+1 with opaque cursors, no dup/skip under interleaved writes; malformed and cross-owner cursors refuse byte-uniformly (SNAPBACK_STANDARD_PATTERN_CURSOR_INVALID); org-wide pages via the app-level cursor complete and duplicate-free (finding f7)

ordinary supported path = owner-partition indexed search: term and prefix queries with highlights and scores over the assignee's partition; per-principal partition negatives; org-wide member search recorded as an explicit GAP with nonclaim (finding f2 — v1 visibility is owner/public-read only)
one-snapshot composition: issue + project + team + labels (join) + bounded comments/activity (take 50) + aggregates; aggregates equal independent authoritative reads; bounded-query inventory recorded

declared optimistic projection through the React provider (headless observers): overlay visible 51ms before settlement, retired by the authoritative live delivery (isAuthoritative), server state confirms status+position; assignee/priority verified authoritatively via envelopes in other checks

documented compare-and-move semantics: two actors from revision 1, exactly one commit wins, the stale mover refuses (generic SNAPBACK_HANDLER_FAILED code with prose message — finding f3), loser rebases on the authoritative revision and commits deterministically; both moves visible as activity rows

second authenticated client with three stream handles: committed comment 107ms, aggregate counts 80ms, activity attributed to the server principal; handle rows equal an independent third-session snapshot; live search deliberately non-claimed (subscribe refuses SNAPBACK_FUNCTION_NOT_LIVE)

additive v2 evolution (optional issues.dueAt + by_org_due index + 2 operations) through the documented live dev loop: watch reload event, inputsHash changed, same seed identity/dataVersionStream, byte-equal counts, runtime rows and assignments preserved, sessions uninterrupted; new index serves dueSoon. differentiators.observation: Transactional human-visible sequence allocation with zero ceremony: ISS-<n> comes from a read-modify-write on the org row inside the mutation, serialized by commit order — the LLP 0135 sequence-counter shape works on 0.1.7 with no dedicated counter service. Frozen Firebase evidence needed a transaction retry idiom for the same fact.
differentiators.mustNotRegress: Serialized commit order making naive counter allocation correct, and the mutation receipt carrying the allocation's snapshotVersion.

differentiators.observation: Machine-checkable settlement receipts on every mutation ({mutationId, outcome, affectedTables, snapshotVersion} beside the typed result) made the conflict and idempotency evidence trivial to collect — no frozen arm had an envelope this rich.
differentiators.mustNotRegress: The structured mutation envelope with receipt and exact commit version.
differentiators.referenceEvidence: scenario-evidence.json A3-08, smoke output in the diary

differentiators.observation: Declared optimistic projections with authoritative retirement: the provider-owned overlay was visible 51ms before settlement and was retired by the matching live delivery (isAuthoritative), with no hand-rolled cache and no risk of counting optimistic state as authority.
differentiators.mustNotRegress: Optimistic layers validated against the generated result contract and retired only by validated live delivery.

differentiators.observation: Opaque cursor custody on the generated keyset pages: malformed and cross-owner cursor presentations refuse byte-identically (SNAPBACK_STANDARD_PATTERN_CURSOR_INVALID) — cursor abuse is a first-class refused surface, not an app bug. No frozen arm's pagination cursors carried authority binding.

Owner-partition text search is maintained inside the source transaction: an assignIssue commit made the row immediately searchable in the assignee's partition (same-run probe), with deterministic scores and plain-text highlights — against frozen Firebase evidence where native search does not exist at all.
differentiators.mustNotRegress: Postings maintained transactionally with source mutations; deterministic exact-integer ranking.
differentiators.referenceEvidence: smoke output (search pre/post assign), scenario-evidence.json A3-05; diaries/0029 LINEAR-09 GAP

differentiators.observation: Live evolution when unencumbered is excellent: the watch reload landed an additive schema change over live data in under a second with sessions uninterrupted, seed identity untouched, and byte-equal counts — a shape the fix for f5 must preserve.
differentiators.mustNotRegress: Sub-second additive reload with non-destructive seed matching and preserved sessions.

differentiators.observation: The whole 12-check suite — fresh seed install, four personas, a live schema evolution, a jsdom React render, and two destructive receipted resets — runs in 4.7 seconds wall; the fastest full-suite loop of the sweep so far (A1 was 6.6s over 13 checks).
differentiators.mustNotRegress: Machine-readable dev lifecycle (ready descriptor + snapback.dev.v1 events + stdin-close stop) that lets suites own their servers.

differentiators.observation: Uniform non-disclosing denials held across every A3 surface — read, detail, directory, stream subscribe, writes, and cursor misuse — consistent with the A1/A2 arms; the outsider's search sees only its own empty partition.
differentiators.mustNotRegress: Byte-uniform SNAPBACK_AUTH_PERMISSION_DENIED on protected read and subscribe; partition-bounded search.
